summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season with an exciting new squad featuring some fantastic signings and a returning player to boost their promotion push. The Ramblers showed competitive spirit in their recent friendly against St Helens, though they'll be looking to convert chances more clinically when the campaign gets underway. With three brand new kits and sponsorship opportunities available, the club is gearing up for an ambitious season ahead.
